faq.title: The things people ask first.
faq.q1: How does the face scan actually work?
faq.a1: Your camera (or an uploaded photo) feeds a face-mesh model that runs in your browser. It locates 468 points on your face and converts the geometry into the slider values FC26 expects.
faq.a2: Yes. The model runs on your device. No image, no landmark data, no scan output ever touches our servers.
faq.a3: Yes. Open the Network tab while you scan — you'll see zero outbound requests. The PWA caches everything once and works offline after that.
faq.q4: Which games are supported right now?
faq.a4: FC26 is fully supported with all 10 facial zones. NBA 2K, UFC, and WWE are in development — Premium users get them at no extra cost when they ship.
faq.q5: Do I need to download anything?
faq.a5: No. It runs in your browser. Tap "Add to Home Screen" if you want a one-tap launcher, but no app-store install required.
faq.a6: Yes. $4.99 once. No subscription, no renewal, no email asking you to upgrade your plan.
